title: Use sky material for sky radiance instead of fog material
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes #122047 

## Additional information

The bug happened because the `_get_sky_material_data()` function is trying to do two different jobs at the same time.

After PR #110956, ENV_BG_COLOR/ENV_BG_CLEAR_COLOR selected `fog_material`, which is correct for drawing the background with `_draw_sky` but for radiance updates in `_update_sky_radiance` it caused problems.

Both paths were sharing `_get_sky_material_data()`, so radiance accidentally used `fog_material` in `BG_COLOR`. That made sky radiance black/incorrect, which made ambient/reflections look unlit.

This fix separates those responsibilities (`BACKGROUND` vs `RADIANCE`) so each path gets the correct material.

I've used the mrp attached to this issue to test the changes
[Screencast_20260807_171610.webm](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b892b2eb-b8c5-4d99-821d-6e1d854cbd25)
